metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 2006 · Silent Hill
metas.description: Rose Da Silva takes her adopted daughter, Sharon, to the town of Silent Hill in an attempt to cure her of her ailment. After a violent car crash, Sharon disappears and Rose begins a horrific journey to get her back.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.9 · 2012 · Silent Hill: Revelation
metas.description: When her adoptive father disappears, Sharon Da Silva is drawn into a strange and terrifying alternate reality that holds answers to the horrific nightmares that have plagued her since childhood.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.0 · 2026 · Return to Silent Hill
metas.description: When a man receives a mysterious letter from his lost love, he is drawn to Silent Hill, a once familiar town now consumed by darkness.
